violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. Store ready to eat foods away from raw meats in 3 door upright cooler. Raw beef stored above/next to cooked chicken, Oreo salad, and pit ham.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Bucket sanitizer due to be changed.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor/walls around laundry equipment in the food storage area have lint build-up and need cleaning.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. 3 door reach in cooler not maintaining proper product temperatures.

Laundering of linens. — --Laundry equipment was not located in area separated from exposed food or from exposed clean equipment/utensil. Laundry equipment located in food storage room adjacent to kitchen.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Move items from in front and beside hand sink to ensure proper access is manitained.
Prep/vegetable sink. — --Prep sink was not plumbed with a physical air gap on the drain line.
Laundered, proper handling, and storage (1 pt deducted)
Clean, proper use, storage, sanitizing solution (2 pts deducted)
